title: Beyond Code
intro: The communities I lead and the recognition that came with the work.

testimonials.name: Tarek Atwan
testimonials.quote: Devanshu is a hardworking and dedicated individual who consistently delivers high-quality results. His expertise in building forecasting models is impressive and his ability to communicate effectively makes him a valuable asset to any team.
testimonials.highlight: His expertise in building forecasting models is impressive

testimonials.name: Priyanshi Tiwari
testimonials.quote: Devanshu's energy and passion for his work are truly contagious, and I was impressed by how he uses real-world examples to clarify ideas, making them easy to grasp.
testimonials.highlight: uses real-world examples to clarify ideas

testimonials.name: Priyanka Khatri
testimonials.quote: I found him to be hard-working, bright, and a skilled communicator. What makes him stand out is his willingness to help others.

achievements.title: Tableau Ambassador
achievements.text: Selected as a Tableau Ambassador two years running to support the global Tableau community and data literacy.

achievements.title: Guest Faculty
achievements.text: I give lectures and run workshops that tie academic theory to how the work is done in industry.

communities.name: Gujarat Tableau User Group
communities.text: Turning data into stories, dashboards into decisions and insights into impact, through meetups and workshops across Gujarat.

communities.name: Gujarat Databricks User Group
communities.text: Meetups, hands-on sessions and live project showcases on Databricks, Lakehouse, Delta Lake and AI for data teams across Gujarat.

communities.name: India AI + Tableau User Group
communities.text: Where AI meets Tableau: virtual and regional meetups with hands-on workshops for analysts at every level, across India.

communities.name: AWS User Group India AI/ML
communities.text: I organise talks, deep dives and hands-on workshops on AI, ML, GenAI and MLOps on AWS for builders across India.

communities.name: IBM AI & Data Community India
communities.text: Expert sessions, workshops, hackathons and meetups on AI, agentic AI, data engineering and IBM watsonx for builders across India.

communities.name: India Modern Data & AI Community
communities.text: India's national Microsoft Fabric user group: live demos and practical sessions on Fabric, Power BI, Lakehouse and data engineering.
